result.instructions: Tools for Jotform, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our forms got the most submissions this month?"; "Show the latest ten submissions to our contact form, with the answers."; "List the questions on the onboarding form and their question ids.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Jotform data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run jotform_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run jotform_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run jotform_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. jotform_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: jotform_get_user
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Get the Jotform account behind the API key: name, email, account type and avatar. Good first call to check the key works. GET /user.

tools.name: jotform_get_usage
tools.title: Get monthly usage
tools.description: Get this month's usage for the account: submissions, uploads, payments and other counters against the plan. GET /user/usage.

tools.name: jotform_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List the account's forms with title, status, creation date and submission counts. GET /user/forms.

tools.name: jotform_get_form
tools.title: Get a form
tools.description: Get one form's details: title, status, URL, creation date and counts. GET /form/{id}.

form_id.description: The id as shown in Jotform.

tools.name: jotform_get_form_question
tools.title: Get a form question
tools.description: Get one question's properties (type, text, validation, options) by question id. The question ids are the answer keys in a submission. GET /form/{id}/question/{qid}.

form_id.description: The id as shown in Jotform.

question_id.description: The id as shown in Jotform.

tools.name: jotform_list_form_files
tools.title: List form uploads
tools.description: List the files uploaded through a form's file-upload questions, with their download URLs. GET /form/{id}/files.

form_id.description: The id as shown in Jotform.

tools.name: jotform_list_form_webhooks
tools.title: List form webhooks
tools.description: List the webhook URLs that receive this form's submissions. GET /form/{id}/webhooks.

form_id.description: The id as shown in Jotform.

tools.name: jotform_list_form_submissions
tools.title: List a form's submissions
tools.description: List submissions for one form, newest first by default, with answers, status and timestamps. GET /form/{id}/submissions.

form_id.description: The id as shown in Jotform.

tools.name: jotform_list_user_submissions
tools.title: List submissions across forms
tools.description: List submissions across all the account's forms, with form ids and timestamps. GET /user/submissions.

tools.name: jotform_get_submission
tools.title: Get a submission
tools.description: Get one submission with every answer, its status, flag and timestamps. GET /submission/{id}.

submission_id.description: The id as shown in Jotform.

tools.name: jotform_list_labels
tools.title: List labels
tools.description: List the account's labels (the folder replacement), with names and colors. Set include_resources to add each label's assets. GET /user/labels.

include_resources.description: Include the assets in each label (default false).

tools.name: jotform_get_label
tools.title: Get a label
tools.description: Get one label's name, color and parent. GET /label/{id}.

label_id.description: The id as shown in Jotform.

tools.name: jotform_list_label_resources
tools.title: List label resources
tools.description: List the assets (forms and other items) that carry a label. GET /label/{id}/resources.

label_id.description: The id as shown in Jotform.

tools.name: jotform_list_form_reports
tools.title: List form reports
tools.description: List the reports (summary and chart pages) built for a form. GET /form/{id}/reports.

form_id.description: The id as shown in Jotform.

tools.name: jotform_get_report
tools.title: Get a report
tools.description: Get one report's settings and its list fields. GET /report/{id}.

report_id.description: The id as shown in Jotform.

tools.name: jotform_create_label
tools.title: Create a label
tools.description: Create a new label in the account, with an optional parent label and color. Creates data; does not change forms. POST /label.

tools.name: jotform_clone_form
tools.title: Clone a form
tools.description: Make a copy of a form with its questions and settings. Creates a new form; the original is not changed. POST /form/{id}/clone.

form_id.description: The id as shown in Jotform.

prompts.name: getting_started

prompts.description: What you can do with Jotform here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: read_the_latest_submissions

prompts.description: List the newest submissions of one form with their answers, or across all forms of the account.

prompts.name: look_up_one_answer_by_question_id
prompts.title: Look up one answer by question id
prompts.description: Read one submission with every answer, then the question properties behind an answer key.

prompts.name: find_uploaded_files_and_webhooks
prompts.title: Find uploaded files and webhooks
prompts.description: List the files uploaded through a form and the webhook URLs that receive its submissions.

prompts.name: check_forms_and_monthly_usage
prompts.title: Check forms and monthly usage
prompts.description: List the forms with their submission counts, and read this month's usage counters for the account.

prompts.name: organize_forms_with_labels
prompts.title: Organize forms with labels
prompts.description: Create a label, then list the labels and the assets that carry them.

prompts.name: clone_a_form_as_a_starting_point
prompts.title: Clone a form as a starting point
prompts.description: Read a form, then copy it with its questions and settings. The original form stays unchanged.
